businesses.name: Ferris Farms, Inc.
businesses.what_they_do: Was a family-owned retail garden center and nursery on Cranbury Road selling flowers, plants, trees, native plants, seeds and gardening supplies. Customer reviews from 2021 mention the owners were retiring, and a 2022 law-firm case summary about the site's redevelopment calls it the 'now-closed Ferris Farms nursery'.

size_signals.signal: Family-owned, single location at 690 Cranbury Rd; still listed on the NJ Jersey Grown garden-center directory
NJ Superior Court matter 'Ferris Farms of East Brunswick LLC v. East Brunswick Zoning Board of Adjustment' concerned a townhome development on 'the now-closed Ferris Farms nursery'

website_review.search_basics: No site; third-party listing pages still carry the old address and category
top_issues: No website found
Business appears closed; property was being redeveloped as townhomes
Stale listings still send people to a closed nursery

agent_readiness.notes: Old directory and gift-card listings still carry name, address and phone, which is exactly the kind of stale record that makes an assistant send someone to a closed business. No hours, services or booking anywhere.

operations_signals.signal: A 2021 customer comment says the owners were retiring that year; there is no current operation to automate

scores.reasons: Closed business, so no opportunity. Closure evidence is solid (court case summary plus retirement reviews), which is why the low scores are deliberate rather than uncertainty.

Appears on the NJ Dept. of Agriculture certified nurseries and dealers directory

listing.reviews: none yet ('just getting started with online reviews')

website_review.search_basics: No owned site: no page title, description, product pages or hours for search engines to use. The top result for the brand name is an auto-generated aggregator page whose hours all read 'unknown'

Hours shown as 'unknown' on the leading directory page
No quote, order or availability request path except a phone call

operations_signals.signal: B2B grower with three sites and no online availability list - every trade buyer request (species, quantity, delivery week) is handled by phone or email manually (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a simple trade-focused site: plant/material list, delivery counties, hours, and an availability/quote request form

top_opportunities.evidence: Three-location wholesale grower whose entire sales cycle is bespoke quotes, currently with no web intake at all

scores.reasons: Zero online presence for a three-location wholesale grower is a total gap; trade revenue across three sites suggests real budget, and a starter site plus a quote form is quick. Evidence is state and aggregator listings, not the owner's own materials.

businesses.name: Barkly Pet Grooming & Shop

businesses.customers: Local dog and cat owners, especially doodle, spaniel and double-coat owners paying $105-$220 per groom

size_signals.signal: Single suite location (2 Legacy Pl, Suite 5) running a grand-opening 25%-off promotion; one groomer named in reviews (Kimberly)

website_review.primary_cta: BOOK EXACT TIME (links to Franpos booking) / GET PRICELIST

Zero LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD (no ld+json scripts found), so hours and services are not machine-answerable

Title tag omits the service and the town

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile first load: delay/dismiss the grand-opening popup and repair the overlapping hero text so 'BOOK EXACT TIME' is visible at 390px

website_review.primary_cta: Student registration page / text the director
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Registration form page only; no live lesson calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Large review wall with named parents and students, degreed-teacher claims, audition outcomes, 2012 NJSBDC Small Business Success Award
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Certificate is self-signed, so Chrome shows a full-page 'your connection is not private' warning before any content; homepage still sells 'Summer '26' pricing

Waiting list for in-home instruction based on teacher availability and location - manual matching of students to teachers

No reviews at all on Yellow Pages ('be the first to review')

website_review.out_of_date_signs: The only web link is a localsearch.com subdomain that returned a Cloudflare 'you have been blocked' page when opened

operations_signals.signal: Every print/sign job begins with a quote and a file hand-off, yet there is no upload or spec form - all jobs are manual (inference from the absence of any web intake)

caveats: Seven of the ten businesses have no owned website, so their agent-readiness scores reflect absence rather than poor execution; they are not directly comparable with site-owning businesses that scored lower for real defects (e.g. Barkly at 1/2/3 beats several 1/1/0 businesses only in kind, not in effort).

Google Maps / Google Business Profile data could not be inspected directly. Ratings and review counts come from directories that republish Google-style data (Restaurantji, Loc8NearMe, GroomerJob, LocalityBiz, Yahoo Local) and must be re-verified on the actual Google listing before any outreach or pricing decision.

Palmeras Entertainment's domains (palmerasentertainment.com and palmerasbowling.com) returned DNS NXDOMAIN from this network; its content review is based on a July 2026 Wayback capture of the same URL, so details may have changed since.

Music Notes Academy and NJC Driving School would not load live because of TLS certificate errors (self-signed and hostname mismatch respectively); their content reviews rely on archived copies of the same pages and should be re-tested from a normal connection before quoting defects.
Palmeras' public hours differ between its own FAQ (Thursday-Saturday 2-10pm, Sunday 2-8pm) and a venue directory (Thursday 2-8pm); treat hours as needing confirmation.
Barkly's on-site review wall shows 5.0 while a Yahoo Local listing shows 3.0 from 2 reviews - review counts are tiny in both cases and neither is confirmed as the Google rating.
Ferris Farms is recorded as closed on the strength of a 2022 law-firm case summary describing the 'now-closed Ferris Farms nursery' and 2021 retirement comments; no official closure notice was read.

Status for Goochie Pooch & Cats Too, Anita's Wags to Riches, Grooming Lounge and Razor Printing rests on directory listings alone; none could be confirmed by a current website, hours page or recent review.
Palmeras' archived homepage FAQ says the venue does not serve alcohol, while a venue directory lists a bar among its amenities - a minor inconsistency, not pursued.
data_gaps: razorprintingcopiessigns.localsearch.com returned a Cloudflare block page, so Razor Printing's listing content and any attached site could not be read.
Barkly's /robots.txt returned an empty body via direct HTTP, so its crawler access rules are unknown.
No Google Business Profile (claimed status, categories, hours, photos) could be inspected for any business, so 'findable' scores are conservative.
No JSON-LD could be checked for Palmeras, Music Notes Academy or NJC Driving School because those pages would not render live; Barkly's page was checked and contains zero ld+json scripts.
Grooming Lounge could not be verified beyond a single Yellow Pages category entry - no hours, reviews, social profile or working phone confirmation found.
Anita's Wags to Riches: no evidence of current trading beyond stale listings; no menu of services, current hours or recent reviews located.
Music Notes Academy: could not determine whether the business is now owned by someone else after the 2024 sale, or whether the (908) 301-6255 number is the active one.
